newsitem.title: USA: Dakota Mining ends merger talks with Ariel.
newsitem.headline: Dakota Mining ends merger talks with Ariel.

text.p: Dakota Mining Corp said it ended its talks to merge with Ariel Resources Ltd.
Dakota said it gave notice to Ariel to end the talks after the completion of its due diligence. Dakota first announced the merger on December 3.

"The company was not satisfied with certain issues at the end of the due diligence period," said Alan Bell, Dakota's president and chief executive. "Essentially, we could not see production rates as forecast becoming a reality," he added.
Bell said Dakota would continue to look for merger opportunities and in fact had identified one, which he declined to identify.
